metadata.name: cerberus_poker
metadata.description: Game-agnostic mental poker protocol program for CerberusPoker

errors.name: InvalidGameState
errors.msg: Invalid game state for this action

errors.name: PlayerNotFound
errors.msg: Player not found in this game

errors.name: RevealAlreadySubmitted
errors.msg: Reveal contribution already submitted for this player and card

errors.name: CardValueOutOfRange
errors.msg: Card value out of range (must be 0-51)

errors.name: TimeoutNotReached
errors.msg: Timeout deadline has not been reached yet

errors.name: NoDeadlineSet
errors.msg: No deadline set for current phase

errors.name: UnauthorizedCreator
errors.msg: Only the game creator can perform this action

errors.name: UnauthorizedPlayer
errors.msg: Signer is not a participant in this game

types.name: AtomicShowdownOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: CardAssignment
docs: Card assignment for deal_cards instruction

types.name: ClockAccount
docs: An account storing the current network epoch

types.name: ComputationDefinitionAccount
docs: An account representing a [ComputationDefinition] in a MXE.

types.name: ComputationDefinitionMeta
docs: A computation definition for execution in a MXE.

types.name: ComputationSignature
docs: The signature of a computation defined in a [ComputationDefinition].

types.name: DealCardToRecipientOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: DealtCard
docs: Stores the dealt card value for a specific player
After threshold decryption by the MXE, the card value is stored here

fields.name: card_value
docs: The card value (0-51) after threshold decryption

types.name: Epoch
docs: The network epoch

types.name: GameCreated
docs: Events emitted by the program for client-side tracking

types.name: GameSession
docs: Game session state — one PDA per game, seeded by [b"game", game_id.to_le_bytes()]
Tracks the full lifecycle of a private card game:
Lobby → Shuffle → Deal → Active → Showdown → Complete

fields.name: game_id
docs: Unique game identifier

fields.name: state
docs: Current state machine phase

fields.name: max_players
docs: Maximum number of players allowed (2-6 for Texas Hold'em)

fields.name: deck_size
docs: Deck size (52 for standard poker)

fields.name: num_players
docs: Number of players currently registered

fields.name: players
docs: Player wallet addresses (up to 10)

fields.name: active_computation_offset
docs: Arcium MXE computation offset for the active shuffle computation
Used to track which computation to await the callback for

fields.name: encrypted_deck_hash
docs: SHA-256 hash of the encrypted deck after shuffle completes
Committed on-chain to prevent deck substitution

fields.name: shuffle_bitmap
docs: Bitmask: which players have completed their shuffle contribution
bit i = 1 means player i has shuffled

fields.name: reveal_bitmap
docs: Per-card reveal contribution tracking.
reveal_bitmap[card_index] bit player_index = 1 means that player submitted
their reveal contribution for that card.

fields.name: unmasked_cards
docs: Revealed card values: unmasked_cards[i] = card value at deck position i
0xFF = not yet revealed

fields.name: card_assigned_to
docs: Card assignment: card_assigned_to[i] = player index (0-based)
0xFF = community card, 0xFE = unassigned

fields.name: card_value_used
docs: Bitmask: which card values have been used (prevents duplicates)
bit i = 1 means card value i has appeared in this game

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp when game was created

fields.name: shuffle_deadline
docs: Unix timestamp deadline for shuffle phase (0 = no deadline set)

fields.name: reveal_deadline
docs: Unix timestamp deadline for reveal phase (0 = no deadline set)

fields.name: pending_reveal_card_index
docs: Card index associated with the active reveal computation

fields.name: pending_deal_card_index
docs: Card index associated with the active deal computation

fields.name: pending_deal_player_index
docs: Player index associated with the active deal computation

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed

types.name: GameState
docs: Game state machine

types.name: MXEAccount
docs: A MPC Execution Environment.

types.name: MxeStatus
docs: The status of an MXE.

types.name: NodeMetadata
docs: location as [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://www.iso.org/iso-3166-country-codes.html) country code

types.name: NodeRef
docs: A reference to a node in the cluster.
The offset is to derive the Node Account.
The current_total_rewards is the total rewards the node has received so far in the current
epoch.

types.name: Output
docs: An output of a computation.
We currently don't support encrypted outputs yet since encrypted values are passed via
data objects.

types.name: Parameter
docs: A parameter of a computation.
We differentiate between plaintext and encrypted parameters and data objects.
Plaintext parameters are directly provided as their value.
Encrypted parameters are provided as an offchain reference to the data.
Data objects are provided as a reference to the data object account.

types.name: RevealCardOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: RevealCommunityCardOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields

types.name: SetUnset
docs: Utility struct to store a value that needs to be set by a certain number of participants (keys
in our case). Once all participants have set the value, the value is considered set and we only
store it once.

types.name: ShuffleDeckOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.
